mathematical_scope: Exact finite-field entrywise Fourier covariance falsification: positive-sign F has FZ=DF, with Ze_j=e_(j+1). It compares every entry of a sampled modular stage and separately counts deviations of its first column from all ones. Covariance plus the all-ones first column uniquely determines the unnormalized Fourier matrix; covariance alone permits arbitrary row scaling, including zero rows.
input_and_guard_coverage: Checks n divides MOD-1, but n=0 divides by zero and n<0 is not deliberately rejected. The root-order assertion checks n and n/2 only, sufficient for powers of two under expected domain; no power-of-two n guard is present. Because 3 is assumed primitive, divisibility gives order n, but that primitive-root fact is inherited rather than independently verified here.
cost_and_scaling: Dense matrix materialization O(N²) if mixer apply is linear, and N² residual entries with modular powers in the Fourier control. No rank/SVD, but the nested control calls pow at every entry. Finite small-size audit, not an implementation of Fourier.
test_evidence: Main lists N8,16,32,64,128. It asserts the Fourier control entries vanish, but does not assert the sampled stage actually has a nonzero defect or first-column error; reported counts must be inspected. No execution.
dependency_identity: unitary_mixer candidate aff6a16c… hash verified only; fixed MOD and primitive generator are imported/assumed.

findings.finding: actual_modular_fourier_defect_entries is hard-coded 0 after assertion checks. Under -O the checks vanish, so this field ceases to be an observed result.
This module reports stage defects; it does not test a whole class of stages or products and does not certify a universal Fourier impossibility.

acceptance_boundary: Accept exact finite-instance covariance calculation design. Require dimensions, field embedding and inspected output counts for any actual rejection claim.
